name: dkj-subagents-shopify
description: An extra team for a Shopify store repo: three specialists -- Liam, Sandra and Steven -- and the tools to work on a theme safely. WHAT YOU GET: start-task opens a branch for a task; push-preview gives that branch its own unpublished preview theme, so you can look before anything goes live; sync-main first brings what changed on the live theme into your repo, without overwriting your own work. THE SAFETY NET: a guard refuses to publish a theme, delete one or push to the live theme without permission, however the command is typed, and adopt-shopify-floor sets that guard and its checks up in your repo. Enable it only in a Shopify repo, alongside 'dkj-subagents-alpha'; a store usually adds 'dkj-subagents-ecomm' too.
